svg.title: Existing alternatives compete with a new component supplier
svg.desc: Competition includes established controller suppliers; integrated propulsion makers; independent assessors that can qualify existing sources; and domestic OEM-backed manufacturing capacity. PDW announced an up-to-US$820 million conditional loan commitment for domestic components, including intended external supply. This is not disbursed funding or operating capacity. Sources: Scorpion and APD offers; Vertiq product https://www.vertiq.co/81-08-g2; DIU assessor page https://www.diu.mil/latest/diu-seeking-recognized-assessors-to-support-blue-uas-ndaa-compliance; PDW announcement https://www.pdw.ai/posts/pdw-receives-conditional-820-million-loan-commitment-from-us-department-of-war-to-power-americas-drone-arsenal; report section 11 and ledger E08-E15.

g.text: A new supplier must beat the buyer's best route.
PDW: up-to $820m conditional commitment; not capacity
